name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana - Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh
briefDescription: PM-USP Special Scholarship Scheme for J&K and Ladakh gives domicile students from J&K and Ladakh a scholarship to study in institutions outside the UTs — covering academic fees up to ₹1.25 lakh/year and a maintenance allowance of ₹1,000/month for up to 5 years.
descriptionMd:
The Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana — Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh (PM-USP SSSJKL), administered by AICTE under the Ministry of Education, was launched as part of the Prime Minister's Development Package for J&K. It provides scholarships to meritorious students from J&K and Ladakh to pursue higher technical, professional and general degree education at institutions outside these Union Territories.

The scheme aims to integrate J&K and Ladakh students into the national education mainstream and is disbursed through the **National Scholarships Portal (NSP)**.
benefitsMd:
**Academic Fee:**
| Stream | Scholarship Count | Annual Fee Ceiling |
|--------|-------------------|-----------------------|
| General Degree | 2,070 | ₹30,000 |
| Technical/Professional (AICTE/MCI/BCI) | 1,630 | ₹1,25,000 |

**Maintenance Allowance:** ₹1,000 per month for up to 10 months per year.
**Duration:** Up to 5 years (for 4-year technical courses) or the course duration, whichever is less.
eligibilityMd:
- Must be a **domicile of J&K or Ladakh** (UT).
- Must have passed **Class 12 from JKBOSE or a CBSE-affiliated school** located in J&K or Ladakh.
- Annual **family income must be ₹8 lakh or below**.
- Must have secured **admission to a recognised institution** outside J&K and Ladakh for a general, technical or professional degree course.
exclusionsMd:
- Students who have taken admission in institutions **within J&K or Ladakh** are not eligible — the scheme specifically targets study outside the UT.
- Students with family income above ₹8 lakh are excluded.
applicationMd:
**Step 1:** Complete **One-Time Registration (OTR)** at [scholarships.gov.in](https://scholarships.gov.in/).
**Step 2:** Log in and select the PM-USP Special Scholarship for J&K and Ladakh under the Central Scheme list.
**Step 3:** Fill in the application — domicile, Class 12 results, institution name, course, family income.
**Step 4:** Upload documents: J&K/Ladakh domicile certificate, Class 12 marksheet, income certificate, admission letter from outside-UT institution, Aadhaar, bank passbook.
**Step 5:** Submit before the annual deadline (typically September–October); your institution verifies and forwards to NSP for disbursement.
